summary: Seanergy Maritime Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held November 4, 2026. Shareholders approved the election of Ms. Christina Anagnostara as a Class B Director serving until the 2029 Annual Meeting, and ratified Deloitte Certified Public Accountants S.A. as independent auditors for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. The filing contains no transactional terms, pricing, stake, or structural mechanics, and the report is incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 registration statements. This is a routine meeting-results disclosure, not a special situation; no deal or arb angle applies.
